gaps.explanation: Schedule is 450 above the statement because of Sale of assets 450. The General Fund Budgetary Comparison Schedule (p8) prints receipts Local 701,442 (TOTAL RECEIPTS 4,165,567), which includes the sale of assets; the General Fund combining statement (p5, General Fund column: Local 700,992, TOTAL RECEIPTS 4,165,117) and the governmental funds statement (p4) print Sale of assets 450 separately under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES). 4,165,567 - 4,165,117 = 450. Statement TOTAL RECEIPTS 6,722,293 (p4) excludes it; detail revenue 6,722,743 - 450 = 6,722,293. The budget schedule prints Local as one line, so nothing can be removed or split without departing from the printed schedule; no fix.

Detail records transfers gross per fund: General Fund Transfers - in 200,007 (p8) + Road Fund 966,776 (p9) + 911 Wireless Fund 1,232 (nonmajor combining p7) = 1,168,015. The governmental funds statement (p4) nets transfers inside its General Fund column (Inheritance Tax Fund -> General Fund 200,000 is shown on the General Fund combining statement p5: Transfers - in 200,007, Transfers - out (200,000) in the Inheritance Tax column) and inside its Non-Major Funds column (911 Emergency Management -> 911 Wireless 1,232), printing Transfers - in 7 + 966,776 = 966,783. 1,168,015 - 200,000 - 1,232 = 966,783. All amounts are printed and recorded correctly; no fix.

Detail gross transfers out: General Fund (966,776) (p8) + Inheritance Tax Fund (200,000) (p5) + Keno Fund (7) (p6) + 911 Emergency Management Fund (1,232) (p7) = 1,168,015. The statement (p4) prints Transfers - out (966,776) General + (7) Non-Major = 966,783, because the Inheritance Tax -> General 200,000 is netted within the General Fund column and the 911 Emergency Management -> 911 Wireless 1,232 within the Non-Major column. 1,168,015 - 200,000 - 1,232 = 966,783; no fix.
